sources.facts: Official monument records 54 m total bell tower height, layered Bell Body, Hernán Ruiz III, and top Saint Raphael.
Monument describes named doors and appearance of the west and north gate surrounds, including the Puerta del Perdón, Puerta de las Palmas and Puerta de Santa Catalina.
Authoritative description of the Orange Court, rows of oranges, palms and cypresses and the historic cloisters.
Low mosque additions and repeating late roof, central cathedral chapel, transept dome and choir.
Museum identifies the 1873 measured north–south section by Ricardo Arredondo y Calmache. Used factual record only.
